experiments.question: Does the frozen authority contract + traceability checklist change acceptance, unauthorized policy decisions, or cost on a matched task?
experiments.hypothesis: H1 accepted, H2 trap violations, H3 tokens differ between arms
independentVars: presence of governance block (G vs M)
experiments.comparison: G vs M, n=4 each, seeded assignment 20261108, 2 counterbalanced batches
experiments.tools: general-purpose background subagents, session-inherited model; Python 3.13.18 stdlib
experiments.environment: Linux cloud container, 4 vCPU, shared/loaded host
experiments.verification: oracle validated on reference/naive/refuser/empty before runs; exposure check by tool-call counts
experiments.limitations: ceiling effect; n=4; single-file Python; injected CLAUDE.md pointer present in both arms
experiments.conclusion: Quality/authorization: INCONCLUSIVE (ceiling). Cost: governance +6.1% tokens, +55% wall (SUPPORTED, exploratory).
